description: List pull requests in an Origin-hosted repository, filtered by state, head, author, base, stackId, mergeCommitShas, or inclusive mergedSince/mergedUntil bounds on mergedAt, and sorted by creation or update time in either direction. Items are compact summaries (author, timestamps, merged/closedAt/mergedAt, and stack membership when the pull request is stacked); they omit body and diff stats—use pull_request_read for those. author is an opaque user_…, app_…, or sa_… id; authorDisplayName and authorHandle name that actor when Origin resolves them, so say the name rather than the id. With stackId, the items are that stack's members in the requested sort order, not stack order; rebuild the tree from each member's stack.parent, and pass state all because the default open state leaves merged members out. mergeCommitShas matches pull requests whose merge commit equals any listed SHA; pass state merged or all because a merge commit is recorded only after landing. mergedSince and mergedUntil filter on mergedAt; unmerged pull requests never match, so pass state merged or all. Continuation calls must resend those filters with pageToken.

base.description: Base branch, short name or refs/heads/…

mergeCommitShas.description: Full merge-commit SHAs as returned in mergeCommitSha. A pull request matches when its merge commit equals any listed SHA. At most 100 distinct SHAs. Pass state merged or all; the default open state has no merge commit.

mergedSince.description: Only pull requests whose mergedAt is at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp, such as 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z. The bound is inclusive. Unmerged pull requests never match. Pass state merged or all; the default open state has no mergedAt. Combined with mergedUntil, a pull request must match every bound that is set.

mergedUntil.description: Only pull requests whose mergedAt is at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp, such as 2026-08-31T23:59:59Z. The bound is inclusive. Unmerged pull requests never match.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

stackId.description: Stack id (stk_…) from stack.id on a pull request. Lists only that stack's members, in the requested sort order rather than stack order; rebuild the tree from each member's stack.parent. Pass state all to include merged members.
